# Task: Descriptive title

Template: copy into pending with a unique stable basename. Remove prompts and
unused sections; follow [record sizes and maintenance](../README.md#task-record-size-and-maintenance).
Folder location owns status. Resolve links from the task's destination folder.

Owner: Unassigned; the coordinator assigns an owner before activation.

## Goal and acceptance

State the result and scope; link authoritative context rather than copying it.

- [ ] State an observable outcome.
- [ ] State appropriate verification and documentation requirements.

## Dependencies and coordination

Omit when unused. For assignments keep worker/role, acceptance/context references,
dependencies/interfaces, editing/resource boundaries, location/baseline and expected
handoff. Link task/decision basenames without duplicating status. Independently owned
implementation scopes use separate tasks; brief read-only assignments may stay here.
Record a brief serial-execution reason when applicable. Workers do not spawn agents.

## Progress and handoff

Keep current changes, blocker and next action; replace obsolete progress. Handoffs
identify artifacts, checks/limitations, docs and remaining work. Contributions awaiting
integration stay active. Reassignment records prior stop confirmation, retained-work
inspection and explicit ownership transfer.

## Verification and documentation review

Follow [verification evidence](../README.md#verification-evidence): check/result,
environment, cleanliness, revision/artifact, relevant dirty-input fingerprint,
runtime identity where applicable and limitations. Distinguish worker/integrated
checks; retain important failures/resolutions. Required independent review records
reviewer, baseline, findings and affected rechecks; disclose unavailable review.
Record full current-documentation review scope, findings, promoted knowledge and
link repairs. Essential conclusions remain here; raw logs belong outside maintained docs.

## Outcome

Fill at archival: completed or cancelled, concise acceptance evidence, remaining
limitations and any actual user-approved waiver. Preserve unique evidence before
shortening; cancellation states why work stopped and what remains.
